title: Goli chalao ya giraao — dono SAATH girti hain
description: Season 2 Episode 6: Horizontal and vertical motion are independent; gravity doesn't care how fast you move sideways.
ncert_chapter: NCERT XI Ch 3 (projectile motion — independence of horizontal & vertical motion)
hook_text: Fired bullet vs dropped bullet 🔫 — kaun pehle?
concept: Horizontal and vertical motion are independent; gravity doesn't care how fast you move sideways.
on_screen_cues: two bullets, same height, dotted paths → "Horizontal: constant speed" / "Vertical: g" → "Same time!" → "NCERT XI Ch 3 · Projectile motion"
pinned_comment: Agar Earth flat hoti aur gun INFINITE speed se chalti... goli kab girti? 🤔
suggested_titles: "Goli chalao ya haath se giraao — dono saath girti hain" / "Projectile motion ka pura secret 60 sec mein"
elevenlabs_script:
Gudiya: [curious] Chintu, ek gun se goli horizontal chalao, aur usi height se ek goli haath se chhodo. Kaun pehle zameen pe giregi?
Chintu: [mischievously] Tum bolo.
Gudiya: [confidently] Haath wali! Gun wali toh bahut door tak udegi, time lagega!
Chintu: [deadpan] Wrong!
Gudiya: [surprised] Kya?!
Chintu: [excited] Dono EK SAATH girti hain!
Gudiya: [confused] Kaise?! Ek toh 500 metre door gayi!
Chintu: [cheerfully] Door gayi, haan. Par gravity ko kya farak? Gravity sirf NEECHE kheenchti hai!
Gudiya: [thoughtful] Toh aage jaana aur neeche girna... alag alag cheezein hain?
Chintu: [elated] EXACTLY! Horizontal motion aur vertical motion ek dusre se bilkul INDEPENDENT hain!
Gudiya: [curious] Matlab gun wali goli aage bhi jaa rahi hai, aur utni hi tezi se neeche bhi gir rahi hai?
Chintu: [excited] Haan! MythBusters ne real gun se test kiya. Dono goliyaan almost same time pe giri!
Gudiya: [elated] Toh projectile ka har sawaal do hisson mein tod do... aage wala aur neeche wala!
Chintu: [proudly] Yahi Class 11 ka pura projectile chapter hai. Ek line mein.
Gudiya: [curious] Chintu, Earth abhi 1 lakh kilometre per hour se bhaag rahi hai... toh hum kyun nahi feel karte?
Chintu: [mischievously] Woh next video mein!
